title: Dancing with Leather Droplets
description: A woman in a purple athletic outfit and black high heels dances beneath four large teardrop-shaped objects suspended in the air. The objects have glossy leather-like textures in blue, black, purple, and green, adorned with woven braids, straps, and dripping paint effects, set against a warm orange and purple background with sketchy figure studies visible on the sides.
prompt: A confident woman with a ponytail wearing a purple sports bra, blue shorts and black high heels dances gracefully with one arm raised, positioned beneath four oversized glossy teardrop shaped leather objects floating in the air, the droplets feature intricate woven braids and straps in contrasting colors of blue with brown band, black with green and tan braid, purple with red, and green with blue, paint drips fall from them onto a reflective floor, warm orange and purple gradient background with faint pencil sketch studies of human figures on the sides
